preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract
Contract must have accumulated ETH balance from swap operations

exploit_hint: 1. As owner, call setOperationsAddress() with attacker's address to set the recipient. 2. Ensure contract has accumulated tokens from trading fees (tokensForOperations > 0). 3. Call forceSwapBack() which triggers swapBack(). 4. swapBack() will swap tokens for ETH and send all contract ETH balance to operationsAddress via low-level call. 5. Attacker receives all ETH that was accumulated in the contract from trading fees.
